supporting_observations.claim: The records near the reported time show machine-account Kerberos activity from WS-MLOPEZ-01 at 13:41:47 UTC, but do not identify a PowerShell process or command.

At 13:44 UTC, WS-MLOPEZ-01 used the proxy to establish a tunnel to download.windowsupdate.com, with a Windows Update Agent user agent and approximately 38.8 MB received. This is compatible with business-hours patching, but does not establish that it caused the reported window.

The supplied records do not establish whether the briefly visible window was PowerShell, what process or action caused it, or whether it was authorized; therefore they do not support either a malicious or a benign disposition for the alerted activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided records contain no PowerShell process-creation event, command line, script-block or transcription content, or direct record of the reported window around 13:40 UTC.
The nearby Kerberos and Windows Update network records do not identify the process that displayed the window or link it to the user's report.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually executed on WS-MLOPEZ-01 at approximately 13:40 UTC.
Whether any command or script ran, and its contents or purpose.
Whether the activity was initiated by Maria Lopez, IT, another process, or an unauthorized actor.
Whether the Windows Update activity was related to the reported window.
additional_evidence_needed: Endpoint process and command-line telemetry for WS-MLOPEZ-01 covering the reported time, including PowerShell, cmd, conhost, and parent/child process relationships.
PowerShell operational and script-block logs, transcription, and relevant console/session or EDR event data for the endpoint.
Patch deployment and Windows Update logs, plus any IT activity records from WS-OHADDAD-01, to determine whether authorized maintenance coincided with the report.
Follow up with Maria Lopez for a more precise time and description of the window, including any visible text or interaction.
unrelated_findings: Google Drive File Stream launched under Maria Lopez's account at 14:11 UTC. Google Drive is not among the approved software/services listed in the environment context; handle separately, and do not use this to decide the alert. (T024-00278, T024-00280)

FILE-HD-01 initiated a TCP connection to WS-MLOPEZ-01 on port 135 at 13:57 UTC. This is an observed connection, not proof of remote administration; review separately given the stated remote-administration practice. (T024-00170)
